note: The consolidated requirement list for the bathtub wastewater overflow trip-lever job. Each row cites at least one source; rows whose requirement is not derived from an official rule are labelled MANAGEMENT-DECISION. No row asserts a value that was not read on the linked source.

requirements.requirement: Remove or replace the bathtub waste-and-overflow trip lever (linkage, plunger and overflow plate) that is stuck inside the concealed plumbing behind the tub wall.
requirements.rationale: This is the reported defect: the trip lever is stuck inside the hidden plumbing behind the wall.
requirements.acceptance: Trip lever operates; tub holds water with the lever closed and drains with the lever open; no leak at the overflow.
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED (code context: 2025 CPC §409.3 Overflow and §404.0 Waste Fittings and Overflows)

requirements.requirement: Repair or replace the bathtub plug/spout and diverter only if that is part of the same assembly or is needed to reach the linkage.
requirements.rationale: One quote covers the waste and overflow () and another covers the lever plus spout with diverter () — the two scopes must be made comparable before pricing.
requirements.acceptance: Written quote states exactly which of waste, overflow, plug, spout and diverter are included.
requirements.verification: USER-PROVIDED SCOPE (two quotes with different scopes)

requirements.requirement: Protect and preserve the existing concealed supply, waste and vent piping; no cutting or replacement of concealed piping unless it is unavoidable and priced as a line item.
requirements.rationale: Five or more licensed plumbers declined to remove the lever from above because of the risk of destroying the hidden plumbing.
requirements.acceptance: Contractor states in writing that concealed piping will not be disturbed, and prices any exception separately.

requirements.requirement: Restore the wall/ceiling opening and any affected finish (drywall, tape, texture, paint) to a condition acceptable to the owner.
requirements.rationale: Access requires opening drywall; the unit is occupied and rented.
requirements.acceptance: Area made good; no visible damage beyond the access opening; daily clean-up.
requirements.verification: MANAGEMENT-DECISION (drywall scope per CSLB C-9 and B classifications)

requirements.requirement: Photograph the existing condition before work and record the finished condition after work.
requirements.rationale: Supports the rental file and protects the owner against damage claims in an occupied unit.
requirements.acceptance: Dated before/after photos stored with the job record.

requirements.requirement: Decide the access route in writing: (a) from above through the tub/valve cavity, or (b) from below by opening the ceiling of the space beneath the tub.
requirements.rationale: The overflow assembly sits in a hard-to-access area; removal from above is preferred but has been declined by multiple plumbers.
requirements.acceptance: Contractor's written diagnosis names the access route it will use and the consequences of each option.

requirements.requirement: Confirm ownership of and authority to enter the storage unit below before any ceiling is opened there.
requirements.rationale: The overflow is reachable only from the space below; that space may belong to another tenant or be a separately leased storage unit.
requirements.acceptance: Written confirmation of the right to enter and to open the ceiling; keys/access arranged in advance.

requirements.requirement: Establish whether the space below is part of the same dwelling unit or a separate tenant space, because a permit is required per structure, unit or tenant space.
requirements.rationale: The DBI fee schedule states a separate permit is required for each structure, condominium unit, existing apartment unit, office floor, suite or tenant space.
requirements.acceptance: Written determination from DBI of how many permits the job needs and in whose name.

requirements.requirement: Confirm with the contractor that the trip lever and linkage of the existing brand/model can be replaced or that a universal kit fits the existing drain size.
requirements.rationale: Replacement parts must match the existing overflow plate, rod length and plunger for the tub depth; the drain size is unverified from the site.
requirements.acceptance: Contractor confirms part compatibility at the site visit, in writing, before ordering parts.

requirements.requirement: Confirm whether any pre-1980 building material (e.g. asbestos-containing material) may be disturbed when opening the wall or ceiling.
requirements.rationale: Opening an old wall can disturb regulated materials; the applicable DBI requirement was not identified in this pass.
requirements.acceptance: Written confirmation from DBI of whether an asbestos survey or notification is required for this scope.
requirements.verification: UNVERIFIED — see Flagged for Review item FL-06

requirements.requirement: The plumbing leg must be performed by a contractor holding a current CSLB C-36 Plumbing licence.
requirements.rationale: C-36 is the CSLB classification that covers the supply of water and the disposal of fluid waste, including maintenance and replacement of those items.
requirements.acceptance: CSLB licence-detail page for the contractor shows 'This license is current and active' and the C36 classification.
requirements.status: MET FOR ALL SHORTLISTED PLUMBERS EXCEPT V12 (suspended) and V14 (not established)

requirements.requirement: The wall opening and finish must be performed by a C-9 Drywall licensee or a B General Building licensee; if the plumber does not hold that classification, the two trades must be contracted in a way that names both licensees.
requirements.rationale: None of the three quoting plumbers (Expert Plumbing Solutions, Bay Area Plumbing, Fast Response) holds a drywall or general building classification, so none can self-perform both trades.
requirements.acceptance: Either one contractor with B or C-9 plus C-36 is engaged, or the plumbing contractor names the drywall licensee in the contract.
requirements.status: OPEN — no one-stop vendor among the three quotees
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED (CSLB licence records and classification scopes)

requirements.requirement: Obtain a written contract with an itemised scope, itemised price, schedule, warranty and payment terms before any work starts.
requirements.rationale: The three quotes on file are not comparable because they describe different scopes, and CSLB publishes specific guidance on home improvement contracts.
requirements.acceptance: Signed written contract listing labour, materials, permit fees, drywall, disposal and any ceiling/wall repair.

requirements.requirement: Cap the down payment and use a fixed price; do not pay large amounts up front.
requirements.rationale: CSLB's published guidance for home improvement projects requires a fixed-price contract and limits down payments to the lesser of or 10% of the contract price.
requirements.acceptance: Contract states a fixed price and a down payment within that limit; balance payable on completion.
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED (CSLB press release text quoted on cslb.ca.gov)

requirements.requirement: Verify the licence again on the day the contract is signed — status, classifications, bond and workers compensation — and check the complaint-disclosure link if one is present.
requirements.rationale: CSLB licence status changes (one shortlist licence is suspended and another's bond was cancelled), and complaint disclosure only appears on the licence page when it exists.
requirements.acceptance: Screenshot or printout of the licence page dated the day of signing, with complaint disclosure opened where shown.

requirements.requirement: Request proof of general liability insurance from the contractor in addition to the workers compensation record shown by CSLB.
requirements.rationale: The CSLB record shows workers compensation only; several shortlisted contractors are certified as having no employees and therefore no workers compensation coverage.
requirements.acceptance: Certificate of insurance naming the owner as additional insured where the policy allows.
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED (CSLB licence records show the workers compensation field only)

requirements.requirement: Obtain a permit determination from the DBI Plumbing Inspection Division before work begins, quoting the scope: this job cuts into and/or removes piping behind the wall.
requirements.rationale: DBI's published answer is that a permit is not required only for minor plumbing work that does not require cutting into or removal of piping; this job does involve access to concealed waste piping.
requirements.acceptance: Written answer from DBI (628) 652-3450 stating whether a permit is required for this scope.
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED (DBI FAQ, archived October 2020 edition — wording to be reconfirmed, FL-02)

requirements.requirement: If a permit is issued, apply for it through the PermitSF portal with the licensed contractor, and expect inspections to be part of the job.
requirements.rationale: DBI requires a valid California contractor licence to use its online permit system, and matches the company name, licence number and business licence number; plumbing permits require a C-4 or C-36 licence.
requirements.acceptance: Permit number issued and inspection appointments scheduled with the contractor.
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED for the portal and for the general requirement; the contractor-validation detail was captured from the indexed text of the DBI page (FL-03)

requirements.requirement: Budget the DBI permit issuance fee if a permit is required: Category 1P is for a single residential unit (single plumbing fixture installation or a single kitchen or bathroom remodel, maximum two inspections), plus inspection time at /hour, /hour off-hour, and per half hour for a re-inspection.
requirements.rationale: The July 2026 DBI plumbing/mechanical fee schedule sets these amounts for permits issued on or after 12 July 2026.
requirements.acceptance: Permit fee appears as a line item in the contract or owner's budget.

requirements.requirement: Apply the 2025 California Plumbing Code together with the 2025 San Francisco Plumbing Code amendments to the replacement work.
requirements.rationale: Permit applications filed on or after 1 January 2026 must use the 2025 California Codes and the 2025 San Francisco Code Amendments, with no grace period; the CPC governs bathtub waste outlets and overflows (§409.2, §409.3) and waste fittings/overflows (§404.0, §404.2.1).
requirements.acceptance: Installed overflow and waste outlet meet the 2025 code as checked by the inspector.
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED (sf.gov codes page and IAPMO e-publication table of contents)

requirements.requirement: Keep the 2025 SF Code Amendments page and the DBI administrative bulletins available for the inspector and the contractor.
requirements.rationale: Local amendments and administrative bulletins (for example Section 108A.8 re-inspections) can change the inspection process for a specific scope.
requirements.acceptance: Contractor and owner both have the link before work starts.
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED (sf.gov DBI codes page links to the administrative bulletins)

requirements.requirement: Give each affected tenant written notice of intent to enter, stating the date, approximate time and purpose, and enter only during normal business hours; 24 hours is presumed reasonable notice, and 6 days if the notice is mailed.
requirements.rationale: A landlord may enter to make necessary or agreed repairs, and the statute sets the notice content and presumptions.
requirements.acceptance: Written notice delivered by the statutory method and dated in the file.

requirements.requirement: Coordinate the work window with the tenants through the contractor, and have the contractor enter only with the tenant present where the tenant consents, or with 24 hours' written notice otherwise.
requirements.rationale: No written notice is required if the tenant is present and consents at the time of entry; emergency entry is also exempt from notice.
requirements.acceptance: Tenant consent or compliant notice on file for every visit.

requirements.requirement: Plan for water shut-offs and hot-water interruptions, and keep the bathroom usable or provide an alternative for the tenant during the work.
requirements.rationale: The unit is occupied; work involves the tub waste and overflow and possibly the spout/diverter.
requirements.acceptance: Agreed outage window recorded in the tenant notice.

requirements.requirement: Keep the storage unit below and the dwelling unit clean, secure and free of debris at the end of each work day.
requirements.rationale: The storage unit is a separate space and the dwelling unit is rented.
requirements.acceptance: Daily clean-up; no materials left overnight without the owner's agreement.

requirements.requirement: Use the three existing estimates as the baseline only, not as a price range, because they cover different scopes.
requirements.rationale: (waste and overflow), (lever, plug and spout with diverter) and (plunger handle repair or adjustment) are not like-for-like.
requirements.acceptance: Every re-quote states the same scope checklist as R-S01/R-S02.

requirements.requirement: Re-quote a single, identical scope with at least three contractors, including at least one that holds both a plumbing and a general building classification.
requirements.rationale: A one-stop contractor removes the seam between the plumbing and drywall legs and the resulting coordination risk in an occupied unit.
requirements.acceptance: Three written quotes on one scope checklist, at least one from a B + C-36 holder.
requirements.verification: MANAGEMENT-DECISION, grounded in the CSLB classification scopes

requirements.requirement: Set the owner's approval ceiling before re-quoting, and include the permit issuance fee and the drywall/finish allowance in the ceiling.
requirements.rationale: Adding the DBI Category 1P fee () and a finish allowance to the quoted labour gives the real decision number.
requirements.acceptance: Written budget ceiling communicated to every contractor asked to quote.
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED fee (DBI Table 1A-C); allowance amount is a MANAGEMENT-DECISION

requirements.requirement: Fix the work window (date, duration) before contracting and confirm the tenant's availability against it.
requirements.rationale: Access to the concealed assembly from below determines the labour time; the schedule depends on the tenant's consent.
requirements.acceptance: Dated schedule agreed with the tenant and the contractor.

requirements.requirement: Ask each candidate for a specific reference or photo of bathtub overflow / trip-lever work, not general plumbing references.
requirements.rationale: The published evidence for this exact task type is thin; the closest match found is Bay Area Plumbing's published bathtub-drain and valve work.
requirements.acceptance: At least one verifiable bathtub overflow or tub-drain reference per shortlisted bidder.

requirements.requirement: Give preference to a contractor that states it works with landlords and coordinates tenant appointments.
requirements.rationale: The unit is occupied and the work may require several visits; Precision Rooter & Drain is the only candidate whose published material states it works with landlords and helps set up tenant appointments.
requirements.acceptance: Written confirmation of the coordination process in the contract.

requirements.requirement: Prefer a contractor with employees covered by workers compensation and a general liability policy.
requirements.rationale: Four shortlisted contractors are certified to have no employees and therefore no workers compensation coverage, which changes the risk profile of work inside an occupied rental unit.
requirements.acceptance: Certificates on file before the first work day.

requirements.requirement: Do not contract with a contractor whose CSLB licence is suspended, cancelled, expired or revoked; re-check on the signing date.
requirements.rationale: One high-review-volume San Francisco plumber on the shortlist currently shows a suspended licence, and a third-party directory misattributes another licence number.
requirements.acceptance: Licence check performed on the signing date and filed with the contract.
requirements.verification: OFFICIAL-VERIFIED (CSLB licence detail and name-search pages)

requirements.requirement: Keep the vendor list to a small number of calls with one stated scope, so each call is comparable and the contractor is not quoting blind.
requirements.rationale: Five or more plumbers have already been consulted; repeated blind calls produce the same refusal pattern without narrowing the access question.
requirements.acceptance: Call log with the same question set, the answer and the stated price for each contractor.

_amounts_policy: Quote amounts are withheld from this archived data file: no official source confirms them. The current figures and their labels are maintained in site-data/ and published on the canonical site root.
